description: This file defines a PHP class 'NonSeekableStreamDecodingEventStreamIterator' that extends 'DecodingEventStreamIterator'. It handles parsing of event streams from non-seekable streams, including checksum validation, reading data in chunks, and implementing iterator functionality. The class is part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically in the API parser namespace.

classes.name: NonSeekableStreamDecodingEventStreamIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for decoding event streams from non-seekable streams, verifying message integrity via CRC, and providing stream parsing capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a non-seekable stream and sets up internal buffers.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Parses a single event from the stream, verifying CRC checksum and extracting headers and payload.

methods.name: readAndHashBytes
methods.description: Reads specified number of bytes from the stream, updates hash calculation, and manages buffering.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the first event by parsing it.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next event by reading from stream and parsing.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the stream has not reached EOF, indicating if the iterator can continue.
